name: MMWorld
summary: 用于多学科、多维度视频世界理解评测的人工标注与合成数据集，覆盖解释、反事实思考和未来预测等能力。
summaryEn: A human-annotated and synthetic benchmark for multidisciplinary, multifaceted world understanding in video, including explanation, counterfactual reasoning, and future prediction.
scaleZh: 1910 个视频 · 6627 组问答 · 7 个学科 · 69 个子学科
organizations: University of California, Santa Barbara and collaborators
organizationsZh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校及合作团队
license: Official repository is MIT; source video terms may vary
licenseZh: 官方仓库采用 MIT；源视频条款可能不同
access: Official benchmark repository and project page available
accessZh: 提供官方基准仓库和项目页
verdict: 多学科视频世界理解评测
wmNote: 多维推理问题可诊断视频模型的因果和预测能力；问答成绩只能间接反映可生成、可交互的世界模型能力。
wmNoteEn: Multifaceted questions diagnose causal and predictive video understanding, while QA performance only indirectly measures generative or interactive world modeling.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2406.08407] MMWorld: Towards Multi-discipline Multi-faceted World Model Evaluation in Videos
evidence.statement: The source explicitly evaluates world-model reasoning with future-prediction and counterfactual questions; restrict inclusion evidence to those tracks.
